subject: OrbitSoft: Order Form - Exhibit C (fee umbrella / carveout) — redlines & next steps
messages:
From: Mark Jensen <mark.jensen@orbitsoft.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com
Cc: legal@orbitsoft.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 09:12:05 -0400
Subject: OrbitSoft Order Form - Exhibit C redlines

Hi Sean —

Thanks for the draft order form. Our procurement and legal teams reviewed Exhibit C and are returning a redline. High-level items they flagged:

- Fee umbrella carveout: we can’t accept a broad carveout that would allow Redwood to pass-through variable third-party charges without constraint. We proposed language narrowing the carveout to bona fide third-party pass-throughs and added a transparency requirement (monthly line-item reports).
- Pricing smoothing: the current exhibit smooths below the committed floor over a long horizon; we asked for explicit formula and a 9-month smoothing horizon instead of 18 months.
- Floor level: legal pushed to a 50% floor on committed spend during a transition period (12 months) given our expected seasonality.
- True-up/lookback: procurement wants a 6-12 month lookback window; they prefer 6 months.

Attached: OrderForm_OrbitSoft_ExhibitC_redline.pdf (redlines + comments). Can we set a short call tomorrow to walk the redlines? Procurement is on a tight timetable — they want final order form by end of month.

Best,
Mark Jensen
Head of Procurement (OrbitSoft)
Mark.Jensen@orbitsoft.com
Attachments: OrderForm_OrbitSoft_ExhibitC_redline.pdf (PDF)

From: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mark Jensen <mark.jensen@orbitsoft.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 11:05:32 -0400
Subject: Re: OrbitSoft Order Form - Exhibit C redlines

Mark — thanks for the detailed pass and the PDF. Appreciate the clarity on procurement timelines.

Quick notes from my side:
- We can live with a tighter definition of pass-throughs, but need to align on a cap and auditability (monthly line items, agreed format).
- Smoothing horizon is negotiable; we generally prefer longer windows to avoid churn-driven volatility, but open to testing 9 months if it’s a limited transitional concession.
- Floor at 50% is a big concession commercially; need internal sign-off before committing.
- Lookback of 6 months is reasonable to discuss.

Looping in Karthik (commercial/legal lead for this deal) and Laura (account lead) to propose redline language and a commercial fallback. Can Karthik and Laura craft a short alternate exhibit and a one-page summary we can send back to OrbitSoft today? Also, Mark — are you available for a 30-min call tomorrow 10:00-11:30am ET or 3:00-4:00pm ET?

Thanks — 
Sean Gallagher
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: redline-summary.md (internal)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, Mark Jensen <mark.jensen@orbitsoft.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 08:20:47 -0400
Subject: Proposed edits — Exhibit C (fee umbrella / smoothing)

Team — I reviewed OrbitSoft's redline and drafted alternative wording that attempts to meet both sides halfway. Key points in the proposed text (attached as plain diff):

1) Fee umbrella carveout: replace "no liability for third-party charges" with: "Provider may pass through bona fide third-party pass-through charges related to hosting or network egress, provided such charges are: (a) invoiced to Provider by a named third party; (b) not amenable to Provider's control; and (c) subject to a monthly cap equal to 5% of monthly committed spend. Provider will provide a monthly line-item report detailing such charges."

2) Smoothing formula: introduce an explicit formula (monthly weighted average over N months) and set N=9 for a pilot period of 12 months; revert to N=18 thereafter unless both parties agree. This protects Redwood while addressing OrbitSoft's seasonality concern.

3) Floor: offer a temporary floor of 60% of committed spend for the first 12 months instead of 50% — that gets materially closer to your ask while preserving our unit economics.

4) True-up/lookback: propose 6-month lookback with quarterly reconciliation.

I attached proposed-exhibitC-diff.txt with inline redline suggestions. If OrbitSoft accepts the pass-through caps + reporting and the 60% floor transitional language we should be able to close quickly.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal, Commercial Contracts (Redwood Inference)
Attachments: proposed-exhibitC-diff.txt

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Mark Jensen <mark.jensen@orbitsoft.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 14:53:12 -0400
Subject: RE: Proposed edits — Exhibit C (fee umbrella / smoothing)

Karthik / Sean — thanks for the draft. Commercial viewpoint:

- The 60% floor for 12 months is acceptable as an initial concession if we get: (a) a hard cap on pass-throughs (5% as suggested) and (b) a clear audit right for OrbitSoft limited to verifying pass-through invoices (no broad data access).
- We should also add a rollback clause if actual utilization exceeds commit by >30% for two consecutive quarters — in that case we would re-open pricing (protects Redwood from runaway usage).
- Request to change the smoothing pilot to 9 months but cap the maximum one-off reconciliation per month to 20% of committed monthly fees to avoid large billing shocks for OrbitSoft.

I've put commercial rationale and a short summary in the attached commercial-summary.xlsx so we can present metrics to leadership. Happy to take a quick call to walk the numbers.

Laura Bennett
Account Lead, Enterprise Sales (Redwood Inference)
Attachments: commercial-summary.xlsx

From: Mark Jensen <mark.jensen@orbitsoft.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: legal@orbitsoft.com, procurement@orbitsoft.com
Date: Fri, 13 Jul 2028 09:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Proposed edits — Exhibit C (fee umbrella / smoothing)

Team — thanks for the quick turnaround and the proposed language. Procurement/legal reviewed Karthik's edits. We can accept the following if Redwood agrees: 

- Fee umbrella carveout narrowed to bona fide pass-throughs with a 5% monthly cap and the monthly line-item report (good).
- 9-month smoothing pilot for first 12 months is acceptable.
- Floor: procurement insists on 50% rather than 60% for the transition; their fiscal model requires this assumption. If Redwood accepts 50% we will expedite internal approvals.
- Rollback clause acceptable as long as there is a mutually-agreed reprice process (30-day negotiation window + temporary protected capacity for 60 days).

We will attach an updated PDF redline (v2) with these changes and a procurement note that they require final signature by 31 Jul to meet their quarter. Also include a DocuSign envelope for the order form if the language is finalized.

Attached: OrderForm_OrbitSoft_ExhibitC_redline_v2.pdf

Mark Jensen
Head of Procurement, OrbitSoft
Attachments: OrderForm_OrbitSoft_ExhibitC_redline_v2.pdf

- We will prepare a final exhibit with the agreed edits and share by COB Monday.
- Schedule a 30-min exec alignment call Monday 11:00am ET — Mark / OrbitSoft procurement + my CS director (cc'd once confirmed).
- If both sides confirm, we'll move to DocuSign with a target to sign by 31 Jul.

If this aligns, I'll finalize language with Karthik first thing Monday.
